case_table_schema.reconstruction: Each case row uses columns and selects a rate, probe metadata and metric_matrix row. Full-case peak/RMS values are also present directly in the last cell. Join metric_matrix base64_chunks, base64-decode, zlib-decompress and verify both hashes. Read C-order little-endian IEEE-754 binary64 with the declared shape. The next axes use metric_groups and metric_columns. Cast sample_count and maximum_error_frame to int; derive maximum_absolute_error_volts as abs(signed_error_at_maximum_volts) and maximum_error_time_seconds as maximum_error_frame/sample_rate_hz. For an empty region, count is zero and remaining packed NaNs reconstruct to JSON null. Every reconstructed metric was checked against the original JSONL. No numeric rounding is applied.

raw_artifact_retention.availability: Raw NPZ archives, probe streams, JSONL, plan and frozen source exist in the temporary working directories at audit time. They are reproducible working artifacts and are not committed or published by this report. This committed JSON retains all case statuses, per-case input/probe/NPZ/array hashes, full-case and event-union/outside-union metrics, source/binary identities and plan hashes.
raw_artifact_retention.path_convention: Each case_id names raw/<case_id>.npz and probe/<case_id>.stdin.txt, .stdout.json, .stderr.txt. Hashes are retained in its case row; array hashes use array_names in the schema.
raw_artifact_retention.omitted_payloads: Individual event-window metric rows and complete repeated event documents are not duplicated here. Their complete originals remain bound by cases.jsonl and plan.json hashes and can be regenerated with the source-bound runner. Complete-case and union/outside metrics are losslessly retained.

verification.metric_audit_method: Recomputed peaks, first maximum frames, signed errors, times, means and output/reference peaks directly from retained arrays. RMS was separately accumulated with math.fsum and checked within eight binary64 epsilons relative to stored RMS; every gate decision was independently reconstructed. No runner assessment helper was imported.
verification.verification_limit: Retention consistency and hash binding do not independently attest the compiler invocation or reproduce the original model/reference calculations. Root performed the original study; this worker audited its retained outputs.

remaining_limits: Synthetic impulse/switched-loss mechanics and synthetic pickup/network parameters; no identified physical specimen or calibrated measurement comparison.
The observed bound applies to the frozen 2097-case plan and sources; it is not a proof over every possible event stream, parameter or input.
Comparison B includes the specified continuous filter approximation and is not an alias-only or audibility bound.
This offline waveform study does not establish callback deadlines, native DAW behavior, or RT-001 acceptance.
Hashes preserve artifact identity and internal consistency, not external attestation of an experiment.
